page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n2 family. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon processor cores running at 2.8 GHz, utilizing hyperthreading with 2 threads per core on the x86_64 architecture. The instance includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It features an L3 cache size of 33 MB, alongside L1d and L2 caches of 32 KB and 1.0 MB respectively. This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, and it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks place the n2-standard-8 in the average tier for most multi-core and memory-bound operations. It achieves a passmark CPU score of 8292.45 and a multi-core stress-ng CPU performance score of 7398.32, both falling within the middle 50% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 413.79 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 37.18 GB/sec. However, certain parallelized and intensive workloads show limitations; the multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench multi-core scores fall into the bottom 25% tier. LLM inference prompt processing for a small 135M model is also relatively weak at 340.65 tokens/sec, though text generation for the same model maintains an average speed of 113.19 tokens/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the n2-standard-8 offers a balanced cost-to-performance profile for general-purpose workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or high-speed local NVMe storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable execution times compared to shared-core alternatives. This instance is well-suited for standard web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate text processing tasks, where its balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio can be fully utilized without incurring the premium costs of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor running at 2.8 GHz, it features 4 physical cores with hyperthreading, a 33 MB L3 cache, and lacks bundled local storage or GPUs. Benchmark data indicates average performance across most standard operations, including a passmark CPU score of 8292.45 and a static web serving throughput of 6.9 GB/sec. However, it exhibits weaker performance in highly parallelized tasks, such as multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench multi-core tests. This instance provides a balanced resource profile, making it a qualitatively cost-effective choice for standard web serving, software compilation, database operations, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the need for specialized hardware acceleration.
